note: JA→AA: eyes troublesome; jokes he must 'put on Spectacles to walk in, about the Streets'. NOT onset (editorial: first obtain/wear refs are 1783).
Laurens→Adams: procured Ramsden spectacles (spare glasses different focus) for JA; bill enclosed.
Adams→Laurens: box received; 'The Spectacles fit my Eye very well'. ONSET evidence_year=1783. Editorial: first obtain/wear refs in JA correspondence.

JA→AA2 from The Hague: 'my eyes have made it impracticable' to keep a travel journal; 'With the utmost difficulty have I performed the writing, which my public duty required of me'. Living FROM-him nearwork ~1y after onset (AFC 5:401).
A Defence of the Constitutions of Government of the United States of America (London 1787–88). Post-wear major textual output.

JA→AA from Philadelphia: 'My Eyes will totally fail me in six months… The Number of Papers to read is prodigious. My Eyes complain most bitterly.' Living presidential nearwork densify (Pass DC). Superseded as ya terminus by 1807 Glasses pin (Pass EQ).

JA→Van der Kemp Quincy: 'Though I can See very well, with Glasses, or without them' + sight economy / nearwork fatigue. SECOND spectacle/glasses self-report 24y after 1783 onset → soft→hard. Also LABOR/ya terminus Pass EQ (not death 1826).
